name: Hayasaka Yuumi
source:
A waitress at the coffee shop “Purun.” She’s a lovely young woman with a laid-back personality who’s always smiling. Naturally, she’s the shop’s idol, and she has many fans who come just to see her.

She’s in her mid-20s, a little older than the protagonist. She tends to act overly mature, but she’s actually a bit airheaded and playful.

She’s quite close with the protagonist, who is a regular at the shop. Even though her personality is a bit ditzy, she’s very protective and often acts like a big sister.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/212421/]Getchu[/url]]
